department: Department of Ecology, Evolution and Marine Biology

deadline.value: The FAQ says December 1 (year not shown); the apply page and Graduate Division directory give December 2, 2026.

gre_general.value: EEMB no longer considers the GRE.
gre_general.quote: EEMB no longer considers the GRE for admission

gre_subject.value: EEMB no longer considers the GRE.
gre_subject.quote: EEMB no longer considers the GRE for admission

supervisor.value: You need a faculty mentor who agrees to supervise you before you are admitted.
supervisor.quote: The graduate program in EEMB does not accept graduate students without support from a faculty mentor.

also.quote: Applicants to the Department must be accepted by a major professor with whom they wish to work and who has agreed to supervise the student's graduate training and thesis dissertation research.

funding.value: Department funds are very limited; funding depends on the admitting faculty, and after the first year the student and advisor find funding.
funding.quote: We have very limited department funds, but we try to fund our students through their first year as much as we can.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the stated requirement.

notes: The department's financial-support FAQ mentions a December 15 date for financial-support consideration; apply by the earlier date.
